# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# PharmacyChecker Research

## **Not Made in the USA**

#### The Global Pharmaceutical Supply Chain and Prospects for Safe Drug Importation

Many consumer products clearly state where those products are made. Not so for prescription
medications. Where our drugs are made and where their main ingredients are sourced affects drug
safety, affordability, availability, and even national security — concerns that have come to the
fore as a result of the global pandemic. Yet there is too little transparency and too much
misinformation surrounding the supply chain of the drugs we take. “Not Made in the USA” investigates
and details the country of manufacture and the source country for active pharmaceutical ingredients
among widely used, brand name prescription drugs.

## Verification Program

#### The PharmacyChecker Verification team accredits international online pharmacies that meet high
#### standards of pharmacy practice by evaluating them in the [PharmacyChecker International
#### Pharmacy Verification Program][54]. To verify that they meet PharmacyChecker standards,
#### pharmacies must prove adherence to the laws in the countries where they operate in addition to
#### PharmacyChecker policies.

[ [Example PharmacyChecker seal] ][55]
* Prescription orders dispensed by licensed pharmacies
* Requires a Prescription
* International sales of controlled drugs to the U.S. prohibited
* Meets website security requirements
* Publishes customer privacy policy on website
* Publishes contact information on website for customer service
* Pharmacist consultation offered to customers
* Quantities marketed on website restricted to a maximum of 3 months' supply at a time
* Disclosure of pharmacy location to consumer prior to purchase
* Marketing claims are truthful and not misleading
[Find Accredited Pharmacies][56]

# PharmacyChecker Research

## **Not Made in the USA**

#### The Global Pharmaceutical Supply Chain and Prospects for Safe Drug Importation

Many consumer products clearly state where those products are made. Not so for prescription
medications. Where our drugs are made and where their main ingredients are sourced affects drug
safety, affordability, availability, and even national security — concerns that have come to the
fore as a result of the global pandemic. Yet there is too little transparency and too much
misinformation surrounding the supply chain of the drugs we take. “Not Made in the USA” investigates
and details the country of manufacture and the source country for active pharmaceutical ingredients
among widely used, brand name prescription drugs.

## Verification Program

#### The PharmacyChecker Verification team accredits international online pharmacies that meet high
#### standards of pharmacy practice by evaluating them in the [PharmacyChecker International
#### Pharmacy Verification Program][54]. To verify that they meet PharmacyChecker standards,
#### pharmacies must prove adherence to the laws in the countries where they operate in addition to
#### PharmacyChecker policies.

[ [Example PharmacyChecker seal] ][55]
* Prescription orders dispensed by licensed pharmacies
* Requires a Prescription
* International sales of controlled drugs to the U.S. prohibited
* Meets website security requirements
* Publishes customer privacy policy on website
* Publishes contact information on website for customer service
* Pharmacist consultation offered to customers
* Quantities marketed on website restricted to a maximum of 3 months' supply at a time
* Disclosure of pharmacy location to consumer prior to purchase
* Marketing claims are truthful and not misleading
[Find Accredited Pharmacies][56]

## Advocacy

PharmacyChecker.com supports the missions of several non-profit organizations to help Americans and
global consumers afford prescription medication, and we encourage you to participate in the advocacy
campaigns of [Prescription Justice][57] and other organizations advocating for access to lower drug
prices.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

2001

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2009

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Follow us and keep up to date

At Bora Pharmaceuticals, it is our shared responsibility to execute every drug program reliably on
time, consistently in full.

[ Get in touch today ][54]

## A global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner
* From sites in North America and Asia, Bora delivers reliable, high-quality drug products to 100+
  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical
products.

with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

# Meds
# made easy

### Capsule is the pharmacy that delivers your prescriptions, the same day, for free—all from your
### phone.

Get Started
Get Started

### Check if we deliver to you

Enter home or work zip code
Submit

### Experience a better pharmacy

[Capsule Pill Bottle]

### Free, same-day prescription delivery

[Capsule Pharmacist]

### Privately chat or text with our expert pharmacists

[Capsule App]

### Get and manage all your medications from your phone

# How Capsule works

[Learn MoreAbout How Capsule Works][8]

### Sign up for Capsule

We’ll coordinate with your old pharmacy or doctor to get your prescriptions.

### Schedule your free
### same-day delivery

We accept your insurance and deliver your prescriptions at a time that works for you.

### We manage
### your refills

We’ll coordinate with your doctor and text you when it’s time for refills.

### Capsule is free. Just pay your copay.

Free, same-day
delivery

A pharmacy you’ll love,

### Everybody loves Capsule

4.9
Google Places and Apple App Store
[Capsule Customer Joseph]
“
Capsule is probably the best designed, most life-transformative product that I have used.”
— Joseph
[Capsule Customer Kerstin]
“
If you can text, you can use Capsule.”
— Kerstin
[Capsule Customer Nancy]
“
There's ton of peace of mind knowing that you can text somebody and you'll get a response right away
about the medication you're taking.”
— Nancy
[Capsule Customer Andrew]
“
My only regret is not having tried Capsule sooner.”
— Andrew
[Capsule Customer Shwetabh]
“
Capsule 100% did everything for me. They took my prescription from my doctor, found the best price,
and delivered my prescription to my doorstep.”
— Shwetabh
[Capsule Customer Olivia]
“
Capsule checks in with me, reminds me when I need prescriptions, and makes it easy to get them
delivered.”
— Olivia
Slide Carousel LeftSlide Carousel Right

## “Designed to make it easier for patients to fill prescriptions and stay on their medications”

— The Wall Street Journal

# Still have questions?

## How much does it cost?

Capsule is free to use. You only pay your copay on your medication.

## Do you take my insurance?

Yes. Capsule accepts all commercial insurance plans, Managed Medicaid, and Medicare Part D. We'll
also coordinate directly with your insurance so you don't have to.

## Does Capsule deliver to me?

Find out [by going here and seeing our list of available locations!][9].

## Can all my doctors use Capsule?

Yes. Any doctor can send a prescription to Capsule.

## I still have more questions.

Text us at [(888) 910-1808][10] or email [help@capsule.com][11]

## Common Questions

Q. How much do deliveries cost?

+------------+---------+---------+ 
|            |  Orders |  Orders | 
|            |  below  |  above  |

+------------+---------+---------+

+------------+---------+---------+ 
| Jashore    | 29      | 19      | 
+------------+---------+---------+

Q. What are your delivery hours?
We deliver from 7.30 am to 11 pm every day. You can choose from available slots to find something
that is convenient for you.
Q. What is your policy on refunds?
We offer a refund or return policy of seven (7) days on most unopened or unspoilt packaged products.
1. For perishable products such as milk, fruits, and fresh vegetables, we have a 1 (one) day return
   policy.
2. Diaper items must be returned for refunds before 10% or 3 pieces (whichever comes first) have
   been used.
3. Certain products; Face Mask, Disposable Vinyl Gloves, Alcohol Pads, and Covid Testing Kits are
   not acceptable for refund or return either opened or unopened.
Q. What about the prices?
Our prices are our own but we try our best to offer them to you at or below market prices. Our
prices are the same as the local market and we are working hard to get them even lower! If you feel
that any product is priced unfairly, please let us know.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

## boundaries of innovation

## Expanding the
## boundaries of accessibility

[slide_innovation]
[slide_patient]
[slide_globally]

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

At Glenmark, we want talent to build more than a career. We want them to undertake a quest full of

Where chasing breakthroughs is part of the everyday and shaping the future of global health the

Where we live, breathe and deliver innovation while also expanding accessibility to high-quality

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

## The GMP+ Company database


Do you want to find GMP+ certified companies, Certification Bodies, laboratories, or partners? The

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries. 

[More about GMP+ International ][52]

[Image]

## GMP+ Feed Certification scheme

The GMP+ Feed Certification (GMP+ FC) scheme provides internationally recognised standards to
produce safe feed, and a growing set of international standards for sustainable feed.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

# Your Global Bridge to Critical Medicines

As a trusted pharmaceutical supplier since 2003, GNH India bridges the gap between the world's most
critical medicines and the patients and institutions who need them. From named patient supply and
orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver
with regulatory precision, cold chain integrity, and a commitment to access that goes beyond
borders.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

### TOGETHER CREATING A BETTER FUTURE

HAPA is a 501 (c)(3) non-profit organization that is inspired by the life and legacy of Dr. Thomas
W. Patrick Sr. Doctor Thomas W. Patrick Sr (1872-1953) migrated from Haiti to the United States as a
child with his family in 1892. While in the U.S, he became a Pharmacist and a Doctor providing
healthcare education, medical services, and pharmaceutical knowledge to the Haitian community.

We, at HAPA, strive to continue Dr. Patrick’s legacy by providing much-needed services within both
the Haitian American community and in other communities where our expertise is also needed.

[ BECOME A MEMBER ][119]

### Our Mission

The Haitian American Pharmacist Association is deeply committed to advancing health and well-being.
We focus on three key areas: Community Enrichment, where we empower individuals through education;
Professional Empowerment, ensuring seamless integration of pharmaceutical care; and Unified
Advancement, uniting our community for a healthier future within a holistic healthcare framework.

### Our Vision

To emerge as a preeminent catalyst for health education and advocacy, with an unwavering commitment
to reaching marginalized communities, and forging critical alliances with healthcare providers,
institutions, and policy influencers.

### Our Values

HAPA stands steadfast on the pillars of Health Enhancement, Community Education, Pharmaceutical Care
Integration, and Unity.

### TOGETHER CREATING A BETTER FUTURE

HAPA is a 501 (c)(3) non-profit organization that is inspired by the life and legacy of Dr. Thomas
W. Patrick Sr. Doctor Thomas W. Patrick Sr (1872-1953) migrated from Haiti to the United States as a
child with his family in 1892. While in the U.S, he became a Pharmacist and a Doctor providing
healthcare education, medical services, and pharmaceutical knowledge to the Haitian community.

We, at HAPA, strive to continue Dr. Patrick’s legacy by providing much-needed services within both
the Haitian American community and in other communities where our expertise is also needed.

[ BECOME A MEMBER ][119]

### Our Mission

The Haitian American Pharmacist Association is deeply committed to advancing health and well-being.
We focus on three key areas: Community Enrichment, where we empower individuals through education;
Professional Empowerment, ensuring seamless integration of pharmaceutical care; and Unified
Advancement, uniting our community for a healthier future within a holistic healthcare framework.

### Our Vision

To emerge as a preeminent catalyst for health education and advocacy, with an unwavering commitment
to reaching marginalized communities, and forging critical alliances with healthcare providers,
institutions, and policy influencers.

### Our Values

HAPA stands steadfast on the pillars of Health Enhancement, Community Education, Pharmaceutical Care
Integration, and Unity.

##### [Cassandra Esperant][121]

Pharmacist

##### Cassandra Esperant

Pharmacist

Cassandra Esperant is a pharmacist at the Aids Healthcare Foundation, specializing in prescribing
HIV prevention medications. She collaborates with a medical doctor through a CPA. She’s passionate
about addressing public health issues in communities facing disparities, aiming to empower them with
tools for better healthcare. In her free time, Cassandra consults and educates on HIV prevention and
public health. She’s active in the SPARK Board for Women’s Empowerment and the Chairwoman of the
Education Committee of the Haitian American Pharmacist Association. Her future goals include
focusing on HIV prevention in Black/Hispanic women and serving on the Presidential Advisory Council
on HIV/AIDS. Fun Fact: In high school, Cassandra confidently told her chemistry teacher she didn’t
need his class because she was going to law school.

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is the flagship company of Shah Group, founded by Mr. Shah in 1976.
An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

Having three decades of experience, Healthy Life Pharma is a WHO recognized organization, which has
certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

## Formulation & Bulk Drugs

Tablets

Available for variety of applications in different forms such as uncoated, sugar coated, film
coated, chewable and more.

Capsules

Wide range of capsules that are available as antibiotic capsules, pain killer capsules, vitamin
supplements & tonics.

Injectables

Safe and reliable injectables that are
available in both powder and liquid
form.

Dry Syrups & Suspensions

We bring to you highly reliable formulation in the form of dry syrup for effective treatment of
variety of ailments.

Eye Drops & Ear Drops

Highly effective eye and ear drops that provide quick relief. These products are available in
sterilized and safe vials.

External Preparation

Avail from us a variety of external application products including ointments, creams and
antiseptic/disinfectants.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

How it works

## Two sides publish. Hell of a Partner matches.

A brand posts the distribution it needs. A distributor posts the capability it offers. Hell of a
Partner scores the fit and brokers the introduction.

Manufacturer / Brand

### Hell of a Partner, the platform

It scores every distributor against each brand's offer on seven weighted criteria, then brokers the
introduction. Contact details stay private until the request is accepted.

Distributor / Importer / Agent

Publishes a capability profile
* Markets and territories covered
* Sales channels operated
* Customer base already served
* Product categories handled
* Certifications held

What makes it different

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

[Browse the catalog by category and country →][8]
* Verified at the source
  
  Matched to official business registries (SIREN, CVR, RCCM and dozens more) or protected origin
  marks like PDO, GI and Genuine Jersey, not a self-declared badge.
* Sorted by category and country
  
  Find a specific product in a specific market instead of scrolling an endless, unfiltered list.
* Reachable even without a website
  
  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

Matching engine

## Matching that explains itself

Every distributor is scored 0 to 100 against a manufacturer's offer on seven weighted criteria, with
a plain-language rationale, not a black box.
* 22%
  
  Country coverage
  
  Share of the manufacturer's target markets the distributor actively covers.
* 20%
  
  Category match
  
  Whether the distributor specialises in the offer's product category.
* 16%
  
  Sales channels
  
  Overlap between the requested sales channels and the distributor's channels.
* 13%
  
  Minimum order fit
  
  How comfortably the distributor's order capacity meets the minimum.
* 12%
  
  Certification fit
  
  Required certifications the distributor already holds.
* 9%
  
  Existing network fit
  
  Customer types served, brand portfolio size, partner-type match, and years in distribution.
* 8%
  
  Trade-agreement fit
  
  Preferential trade arrangements between the offer's target markets and the distributor's coverage
  (EAEU, EU, ASEAN, USMCA, CPTPP, AfCFTA, bilateral FTAs).

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

### Wide range of innovations; diverse and differentiated product portfolio

[Read More][71]

## At Hetero, our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of
## life-saving medicines across the world.

With unparalleled strengths in pharmaceutical research, manufacturing, and marketing, we are
positioned to serve people regardless of geographies. Our new identity embodies this drive to expand
our reach and capabilities in order to respond with agility to the world’s evolving health needs.
Our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of life-saving
medicines across the world.

## Partnering with MPP to expand access of nirmatrelvir & ritonavir generics for COVID-19 treatment

To ensure significant increase in access to COVID-19 treatments for all people, particularly those
living in the poorest parts of the world.

[Read More][72]

## Positive results in Phase III trials of Hetero’s Movfor (Molnupiravir)

Demonstrated that Molnupiravir along with Standard of Care (SOC) reduced the risk of hospitalization
by over 65% compared to SOC alone.

[Read More][73]

# Closing the Therapeutic Gap: Globale Arzneimittel-Versorgung

Ihr Spezialist für Einzelimport, Lieferengpass-Lösungen und Unlicensed Medicines weltweit seit über
50 Jahren.

**INFOrmationen für Patienten**

## Endverbraucher

Sehr geehrte Endverbraucher,
ilapo beliefert Apotheken, Tierärzte und pharmazeutische Großhändler. Bitte wenden Sie sich mit
Ihren Anfragen oder Ihrem Rezept an eine Apotheke vor Ort. Diese tritt dann bezüglich Ihres
Anliegens mit uns in Kontakt.

[Weitere Informationen][38]

### Für Apotheken, Krankenhäuser und den pharmazeutischen Großhandel beschaffen wir sicher und
### schnell Unlicensed Medicines für die Therapie.

[apothekerin]
[ Arzneimittelvertrieb weltweit: Unlicensed Medicines ][39]

### Pharmaherstellern, Generikaunternehmen und Biosimilar Firmen bieten wir hochwertige
### Fertigarzneimittel als Referenzprodukte (RLD: Reference Listed Drugs).

[Frau in der Apotheke]
[ Referenz­­­produkte für die Arzneimittel­­herstellung ][40]

### Wir unterstützen internationale Projekte im Bereich der klinischen Forschung. Wir liefern
### Großhändlern und Pharmaherstellern Vergleichspräparate (Comparator Drugs) für klinische Studien.

[Reagenzgläser im Labor]
[ Vergleichspräparate für Klinische Studien ][41]

### Für die Pharmazeutische Industrie sind wir von ilapo gerne ein verlässlicher Partner im Early
### Access Program / Härtefallprogramm (Compassionate Use).

[Apothekerin verabreicht Medikament]
[ Early Access Program ][42]

## Lieferengpässe? Wir helfen - mit Import-Arzneimitteln aus dem Ausland.

Per Einzelimport nach § 73 Abs. 3 AMG - erstattungsfähig durch die GKV. Finden Sie jetzt mit unserem
"Engpasslöser" eine Liste mit aktuellen Austauschpräparaten bei Arzneimittel-Lieferproblemen.

[ Zur Engpasslöser-Liste ][43]

## Engpässe und Lösungen immer im Blick!

Abonnieren Sie den "Engpasslöser" als Newsletter, um stets die Liste auf dem neuesten Stand zu
haben.

[ Newsletter jetzt abonnieren! ][44]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

уютная и доброжелательная обстановка в доме, мудрые родители и умные, послушные и здоровые дети -
это, на мой взгляд, самое главное, что нужно человеку для счастья.

Но как добиться такой семейной идиллии? Достичь счастья в личной жизни удается, увы, далеко не всем.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

**Conference Benefits:**

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

**Conference Benefits:**

•   Live Sessions
•   Certification of Recognition
•   Meet your Academic idols
•   Hear about latest research
•   Engage in High level debates & Q/A
•   Networking for future collaboration
•   Add Research Value
